description: Create geography quiz questions: guess the country from its flag or outline, pick the capital, pick the most populated country, or name a neighbour. Ask the user one question at a time, then pass the user's answer and the question's ticket to check_answer. Do not guess the answer yourself, and do not reveal it before check_answer.

difficulty.description: easy: well-known countries. hard: lesser-known countries, wrong options from the same area, look-alike flags.

locale.description: Language for names, capitals and links.

type.description: flag: name the country from its flag. capital: pick the capital. shape: name the country from its outline. population: pick the most populated of four. borders: name a neighbouring country.

name: create_quiz

how_to_play.description: How to run the quiz with the user.

lives.description: Wrong answers that end the run.

play_url.description: A page on the site to play. Share it once.

image_url.description: The flag or outline to show, on flag and shape questions.

options.description: Empty for a borders question, which is free text.

ticket.description: Send this to check_answer. It hides the answer.

type.description: The quiz type that was asked for.

title: Create a geography quiz
